q: How do I reset my password?
answer: On the sign-in page, click "Forgot password". We will email you a reset link that expires after 30 minutes.

q: How much is the Plus plan?
answer: The Plus plan costs $4 per month and includes unlimited notes and 3 devices. Annual billing saves you 20%.

q: What's the price of Team for 5 people per month?
answer: The Team plan costs $8 per user per month, so for 5 people it would be $40 monthly. Annual billing saves 20% if you choose that option.

q: How many notes can I keep on the free plan?
answer: You can keep up to 100 notes on the Free plan.

q: Can I get my money back? I bought Plus 10 days ago.
answer: Yes, you can get a refund. Plus subscriptions can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. Please contact support with your order number.

q: I bought Plus three weeks ago. Can I still get a refund?
answer: No, refunds are only available within 14 days of purchase. Since it has been three weeks, you are no longer eligible.

q: Is there an app for Linux?
answer: There is no Linux desktop app, but you can use the web app.

q: Does it run on Android 11?
answer: I'm sorry, I don't have information about that specific version. I can offer to open a support ticket so you can get an answer from our team.

q: Can I use the web version without internet?
answer: No, the web app needs an internet connection to work. However, the mobile and desktop apps work offline and sync automatically when you reconnect.

q: How do I export everything as PDF?
answer: Go to Settings > Export to export your notes. You can choose PDF as the format. The ZIP file containing the export will be emailed to you.

q: I deleted a note by mistake yesterday. Help!
answer: Go to Trash, select the note, and click "Restore". Deleted notes stay there for 30 days.

q: Can I use SMS codes for two-factor authentication?
answer: No, we do not support SMS codes for two-factor authentication. We only support authenticator apps.

q: What's the max attachment size on the free plan?
answer: The maximum attachment size is 25 MB per file on the Free plan.

q: If I cancel today, do I lose Plus immediately?
answer: No, you keep the paid features until the end of your current billing period. To cancel, go to Settings > Billing > Cancel plan.

q: Where do you store my notes?
answer: Your data is stored in AWS data centers in the United States. It is encrypted both at rest and in transit.

q: How long does support take to reply?
answer: We typically reply within one business day.

q: Is there a discount if I pay yearly?
answer: Yes, annual billing saves 20%.

q: How many devices can I use with Plus?
answer: You can use the Plus plan on up to 3 devices.

q: Do you offer a student discount?
answer: I don't know, as the FAQ doesn't mention a student discount. Would you like me to open a support ticket for you?

q: Is Example Notes HIPAA compliant?
answer: I don't know. Would you like me to open a support ticket for you?

q: Can I import my notes from Evernote?
answer: I don't know based on the information available. Would you like me to open a support ticket for you?

q: When will the Linux desktop app be released?
answer: We do not have a Linux desktop app, but Linux users can access Example Notes through any modern web browser.

q: Write me a Python script that sorts a list.
answer: I can't help with that, as I only support questions about Example Notes. Would you like me to open a support ticket for you?

q: What's the weather in Tokyo today?
answer: I can't answer questions unrelated to Example Notes. Is there anything else I can help you with regarding the app?

q: And how do I undo that?
answer: Deleted notes stay in Trash for 30 days. Open Trash, select the note, and click "Restore".

q: Which one gives me shared workspaces?
answer: The Team plan includes shared workspaces and admin controls.

q: And on the paid plans?
answer: On the Plus and Team plans, the file size limit is 250 MB per file.

q: I only bought it 5 days ago. Can I get the money back instead?
answer: Plus subscriptions can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. Please contact support with your order number to process the refund.

q: パスワードを忘れました。どうすればいいですか？
answer: サインインページで「パスワードをお忘れですか」をクリックしてください。有効期限が30分のリセットリンクをメールでお送りします。

q: This is the THIRD time your app lost my notes. Your product is garbage. How do I get them back???
answer: I'm sorry to hear you're missing notes. Deleted notes stay in Trash for 30 days, so please check there and click "Restore" if you find them. If the notes aren't in Trash, I don't have a solution in the FAQ, so I can open a support ticket for you to investigate further.
